::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded May 2024 in Bengaluru by CEO Sunil Kumar (formerly of Arm, Broadcom, Intel). Taped out test chips in 2025; raised $9M total (a $3M seed led by Vertex Ventures SEA & India in Aug 2024, plus a $6M pre-Series A).
:::

## What does this firm design?

Sovereign AI vision chips for surveillance and CCTV, featuring an indigenous end-to-end security stack, a privacy/authenticity engine, and a dual-sensor edge-AI ISP designed with a zero-backdoor architecture.
